scope: Executable PCI BAR sizing, guest MMIO allocation, and passthrough capability reference model

components: abstract transactional Type-0/Type-1 BAR write-all-ones probe with a guarded Linux sysfs backend
linked OVMF X-PciMmio64Mb and QEMU pci-hole64-size output

lint.command: ruff check pci-resource-model && ruff format --check pci-resource-model

wheelInstall.consoleSmoke: installed pci-resource-model allocate command reproduced the 2 GiB result

safetyBoundaries: Linux scan consumes kernel-probed sysfs resources and never writes live BARs
Direct BAR sizing requires an explicit ConfigSpace backend and a quiesced exclusively owned function
ACS override never reuses the patched kernel group as physical-isolation proof
Estimated bus-reset domains and missing dependency inventory fail closed by default
MMIO admission is separate from static capability
remainingPhysicalValidation: live unbound hardware BAR write-all-ones transaction and restoration
override-independent physical isolation domain capture on the target host
firmware-stage bridge-window placement and post-boot guest BAR verification
